recipe.build:
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_NODEJS_LTS_PATH}" -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-${PROVISIONING_CACHE_NODEJS_LTS_VERSION}-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME=/opt/gradle
npm install
export REACT_APP_VERSION="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
npm run build
npx cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-${PROVISIONING_CACHE_NODEJS_LTS_VERSION}-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME=/opt/gradle
npm install
export REACT_APP_VERSION="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
npm run build
npx cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
